title: A remote sender's mailbox send fails with 409 "federation link changed" across a Central outage and has no supported sender-intent reconciliation
outcome: A send from a satellite session that is interrupted by a link change or Central outage is either delivered exactly once automatically when the link returns, or its intent status can be read and reconciled through a supported interface, without manual identical-key retries guided only by local evidence.
acceptance: The 409 'federation link changed; reconnect and reconcile the original operation' path is traced to its code, and the documented reconciliation for the sender is identified or found missing.
Either automatic exactly-once delivery after link recovery or a supported sender-intent status read exists, with a regression test that changes the link mid-send and asserts exactly one delivery.
